notes: seo-autopilot.yml is the only scheduled workflow (daily 06:00 UTC + manual).
All other 10 workflows are workflow_dispatch only — zero push/PR triggers.
seo-autopilot.yml already has 'Force success' step (if: always()) so it never fails.
apply-ads-changes.yml has 'exit 1' for validation but is manual-only — no email noise.
No workflow creates PRs, issues, or comments.
should-commit.mjs gates commits to meaningful changes only.
workflows-noise.mjs auditor detects reintroduced push triggers.
